integrity: For a crown labeling with side sums X and Y, the defining constraints are exactly 3 <= x_i + Y - y_i <= 4 when x_i <= 1 and the symmetric inequalities when y_i <= 1. These equations exclude every weight below six, force X=Y=3 at equality, and then force x_i=y_i coordinatewise. Conversely every common side vector of total weight three satisfies the definition with closed-neighborhood sum exactly three at every constrained coordinate.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats balanced crown graphs with n at least four.
The boundary graph Cr_3 has additional minimum functions and is excluded from the optimizer classification.
Finite verification checks only weights at most six, which is sufficient for the minimum and minimizer claims.
A differently phrased or non-indexed crown treatment may exist.
title: Perfect double Italian domination of crown graphs
